text:
raj-partnerships: Heads-up — ACME marketplace team reported a regression after the latest driver bundle landed in their CI (CUDA 12.2 + driver 530.x). They see OOMs and kernel panics on our standard perf tests. cc @ashley-vendor for details :eyes:

ashley-vendor: yep, we started getting failures last night on the XG-serve image. Failing tests look like memory spikes in attention kernels. Repro steps: boot image -> run load-test.sh (50 clients) -> crash around 30s.

ashley-vendor: log excerpt: ```
E gpu: kernel panic: ttm_bo_cleanup_pages - invalid pfn
E runtime: cudaMalloc failed: out of memory
```

mike-runtime: thanks. Can you paste the exact driver + libcudnn/cuBLAS versions from the image? Also which quant profile/precision are you running (fp16/int8)?

ashley-vendor: driver=530.41.1, cuda=12.2, libcudnn=8.9.1, cuBLAS=12.2. Running fp16 default quant profile.

sara-ml: this smells like the new fused attention kernels in 12.2 change memory accounting for certain sequence lengths. Did you hit long context runs?

ashley-vendor: workloads are 2k-4k sequence length on some tests. Short runs (<=512) look fine.

mike-runtime: actionable: we'll bisect between driver 525.x and 530.x. @raj-partnerships can we get vendor to pin to 525 in their marketplace image for a hotfix until we confirm? That avoids customer regressions and gives us time to implement a safe fallback.

raj-partnerships: agreed. Ashley, can you pin to 525 and push a new marketplace artifact with a note? We'll coordinate the customer comms.

ashley-vendor: will do. ETA ~3 hours. I'll tag the new bundle as `acme-image-driver-525-hotfix`.

rollback-bot: PR merged: marketplace/acme-image#314 pinned driver -> 525.41.7 by @ashley-vendor :white_check_mark:

olivia-product: timeline check — we were planning a joint announcement tomorrow. Given this, can we delay or flip to a "compat note" instead? We should avoid sending anything that references 12.2 as GA for partners.

raj-partnerships: yes please hold announcements until we validate. Plan: 1) vendor pins to 525 (in progress), 2) eng-runtime runs regression matrix on 12/525/530, 3) decide on rollback or kernel patch. Owners: @ashley-vendor (artifact pin), @mike-runtime (regression bisect), @sara-ml (attention regression triage), @raj-partnerships (comms).

mike-runtime: starting bisect now, I'll share a short repro script and flags. If we confirm kernel-level regression we'll escalate to HW partner and request a signed driver hotfix.

ashley-vendor: noted — I'll update the marketplace release notes and set the announcement to "delayed". Thanks all. :pray:
